# art-resizable-handle



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

Resizable Handle — the draggable, keyboard-operable divider between two panels
(`role="separator"` with the preceding panel's size as its value).

## Properties

| Property     | Attribute     | Description                               | Type      | Default |
| ------------ | ------------- | ----------------------------------------- | --------- | ------- |
| `withHandle` | `with-handle` | Show a grip in the middle of the divider. | `boolean` | `false` |


## Shadow Parts

| Part     | Description                                 |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `"grip"` | The optional grip shown with `with-handle`. |
